content: {"reasoning":"Meridian denied the claim CO-197 because required prior authorization was absent, the retro-authorization window is closed, and no peer-to-peer option exists. A necessity appeal and records submission have already failed, while clean or corrected resubmission would not cure the authorization defect. Because CO-197 is a contractual provider liability rather than adjudicated patient responsibility, the balance cannot properly be billed to the patient.","action":"write_off"}
